subject: Request: permission to cite SOC 2 / ISO attestation in customer case study
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@acme.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 16:12:00 -0400
Subject: Request: permission to cite SOC 2 / ISO attestation in customer case study

Hi Sam —

Hope you're well. We're finalizing the Acme case study draft and would like to include a short security/compliance statement referencing Acme’s attestations (SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001). Two asks: could Acme confirm we may (1) state that Acme holds a SOC 2 Type II attestation and ISO 27001 certification (redacted where required) and (2) approve a brief security blurb and logo usage for the public case study.

I've attached the draft case study and a proposed one‑paragraph security blurb under the "Security posture" section to make this quick. If you prefer, we can remove any mention of the attestation and instead say "meets industry standard security controls."

We'd also appreciate a short approval email (or a one‑line quote) we can include under the security section. If legal needs to review, please loop them in. Target publish date is May 21, so a sign‑off by EOW (May 14) would be ideal.

Attachments: draft_case_study_v1.docx, proposed_security_blurb.txt

Thanks — looking forward.

—Rachel
Rachel Kim
Sales Director, Redwood Inference
mailto:rachel.kim@redwood.com
(415) 555‑0192

From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@acme.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>, legal@acme.com
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 19:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: permission to cite SOC 2 / ISO attestation in customer case study

Thanks, Rachel — appreciate the heads up and the draft. Happy in principle for Redwood to reference that we have a SOC 2 Type II attestation and ISO 27001 certification, but I need legal (Priya) to confirm acceptable wording and whether we can include the redacted attestation document or certificate image.

Looping in Priya and our legal alias for formal review.

—Sam
Sam Patel
Head of IT Security, Acme, Inc.
sam.patel@acme.com

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Sam Patel <sam.patel@acme.com>
Cc: legal@acme.com
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 10:14:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: permission to cite SOC 2 / ISO attestation in customer case study

Hi Rachel —

Thanks for the draft. A few legal points before we can approve publication:

- We can approve a short factual statement that Acme has a SOC 2 Type II attestation and an ISO 27001 certificate; any mention of the auditor or detailed scope must be omitted unless pre‑approved.
- We do not permit publishing the unredacted certificate image or any report that contains Control narratives or evidence details. A redacted certificate (company name, attestation type, date) is acceptable.
- If Redwood wants to include a quote attributed to Acme / Sam Patel, we need to see the exact quote before publishing.
- We require a short permissions email or a signed permission PDF from Acme’s legal team confirming the approved wording.

If you can provide the proposed blurb (we'll review below) and a redacted copy of the certificate, we can aim to sign off by EOD Thursday, May 14.

Please include laura.bennett@redwood.com and marcus_lin@redwood.com in replies so our teams coordinate on the final placement.

Thanks,
Priya Shah
General Counsel (external)
Priya.Shah@acme.com

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>, Sam Patel <sam.patel@acme.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 15:27:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: permission to cite SOC 2 / ISO attestation in customer case study

Hi Priya / Sam —

Thanks for the clarity. Attached is the redacted SOC 2 certificate (acme_redacted_soc2_certificate.pdf) and the exact one‑sentence security blurb we propose for inclusion:

"Security posture: Acme, Inc. maintains an independent SOC 2 Type II attestation (redacted) and holds ISO 27001 certification; controls and certificates are managed per Acme's compliance program."

If you prefer alternate phrasing we can update immediately; we can also shorten to: "Acme maintains SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 attestation."

For a one‑line quote we propose: 
"Working with Redwood has helped us safely deploy LLM features at scale without compromising customer data protections." — Sam Patel, Head of IT Security, Acme

Quick ask: Please confirm by EOD Thu May 14 whether (A) the short blurb above is okay, (B) the redacted certificate attachment is acceptable for reference (not for public download), and (C) whether you can provide a signed permission PDF or short email we can attach to the case study record.

Attachments included: acme_redacted_soc2_certificate.pdf, proposed_security_blurb.txt

Appreciate the fast turnaround — happy to hop on a 15‑minute call if helpful.

—Rachel
Rachel Kim
Sales Director, Redwood Inference

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Sam Patel <sam.patel@acme.com>
Cc: legal@acme.com
Date: Thu, 14 May 2026 19:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: permission to cite SOC 2 / ISO attestation in customer case study

Rachel / Sam —

Thanks for the updates and the redacted certificate. Legal approves the following final wording with a small edit for accuracy:

"Security posture: Acme, Inc. maintains an independent SOC 2 Type II attestation (redacted) and is ISO 27001 certified; controls and certificates are managed under Acme's compliance program."

Two notes: please do not publish the redacted certificate image as a downloadable asset on the public post (it may be used internally by Redwood for audit purposes only), and please do not refer to our auditor by name.

We have attached a signed permission letter (acme_signed_permission.pdf) authorizing Redwood to reference the attestation and the above wording in the public case study. If you would like a short quote from Sam, he has approved the following: 

"Redwood enabled us to deliver secure LLM features quickly while preserving our compliance posture." — Sam Patel, Head of IT Security, Acme, Inc.

This email and the attached signed permission serve as legal sign‑off; you may proceed with publication using the approved blurb and quote.

Best,
Priya Shah
General Counsel, Acme, Inc.

Attachments: acme_signed_permission.pdf
